profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I have over five years of experience in full stack development, working with various technologies and frameworks, such as React, Python, Django, Node.js, and GCP. Previously, I was a Front End Engineer at AWS, where I worked on the new Elastic Container Service console, implementing features, tests, and automation. Before that, I was a Full Stack Developer at Colgate-Palmolive, where I created APIs, deployed to the cloud, and made consumer-grade front ends for different applications. I also had the opportunity to mentor and manage multiple interns.

I am passionate about learning new technologies and solving complex problems with innovative solutions. I value collaboration, feedback, and continuous improvement, and I strive to deliver high-quality products that meet the needs and expectations of the users and the stakeholders. My goal is to grow as a Software Engineer and contribute to the advancement and impact of Google's search platform.

positions.locationName: Jersey City, New Jersey, United States
positions.description:
• Worked on new AWS Elastic Container Service console front end using React and Typescript
• Implemented thorough unit and integration tests
• Created automated pipeline for continuous integration

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Created APIs utilizing Django rest framework
• Deployed to Google Cloud Platform App Engine
• Made consumer-grade front end with ReactJS and Material UI
• Piloted test-driven development and Agile practices
• Migrated data from on-premise SAP systems to the cloud using Python
• Managed and mentored multiple interns through Colgate’s structured program

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Acted as technical lead on major work packages
• Served as a crucial resource developing a customer business planning web application utilized globally by thousands of end users
• Learned SAP’s UI5 framework and functioned as an expert resource
• Implemented critical performance tracking in the backend 
• Presented and engaged with business users regularly for feedback
• Optimized backend ABAP code resulting in performance increases of ~70%
• Created multiple UI5 web applications to streamline configuration and maintenance 
• Worked with interns on various projects and supplied valuable input
• Exercised Scrum methodology to manage projects

positions.title: Mobile Development Intern
positions.description:
• Created a hybrid mobile application using technologies such as Cordova, Ionic, Javascript, and Google Maps API for employees to navigate the 3.4 million square foot corporate campus
• Utilized Jira’s agile methodology in conjunction with Git versioning to manage and collaborate on projects
